answer: LIST d, cpi, ba, bs FROM ArtifactRating has ArtifactsCore a AND ALSO has ArtifactRatingHistSign hs AND ALSO has ArtifactRatingResearchScore rs AND ALSO has ArtifactRatingCulturalScore cs AND ALSO a has ArtifactsCoreDynasty d AND ALSO a OPTIONALLY has ArtifactsCoreConserveStatus st AND ALSO a is of ConditionAssessment has LightAndRadiationReading has EnvironmentalReadingsCore e AND ALSO e is of ConservationAndMaintenance c AND ALSO c has ConservationAndMaintenanceBudgetAlloc ba AND ALSO c has ConservationAndMaintenanceBudgetStat bs AND ALSO ((hs + rs + cs) * (10 - if(st = 'Excellent', 1, if(st = 'Good', 3, if(st = 'Fair', 5, if(st = 'Poor', 7, if(st = 'Critical', 10, nullif(1, 1)))))))) / 30 AS cpi

LIST id, nm, erf, o FROM SensitivityData has ArtifactsCore a AND ALSO a has ArtifactsCoreARTregID id AND ALSO a has ArtifactsCoreTitle nm AND ALSO OPTIONALLY has SensitivityDataEnvironmentLight l AND ALSO OPTIONALLY has SensitivityDataEnvironmentTemperature t AND ALSO OPTIONALLY has SensitivityDataEnvironmentHumidity h AND ALSO OPTIONALLY has SensitivityDataEnvironmentVibration v AND ALSO OPTIONALLY has SensitivityDataEnvironmentPollutants p AND ALSO (if(l = 'Low', 1, if(l = 'Medium', 5, if(l = 'High', 10, 0))) + if(t = 'Low', 1, if(t = 'Medium', 5, if(t = 'High', 10, 0))) + if(h = 'Low', 1, if(h = 'Medium', 5, if(h = 'High', 10, 0))) + if(v = 'Low', 1, if(v = 'Medium', 5, if(v = 'High', 10, 0))) + if(p = 'Low', 1, if(p = 'Medium', 5, if(p = 'High', 10, 0)))) / 5 AS erf AND ALSO json(concat('{', concat(substr(concat(concat(if(l = 'High', ',"light": "High"', ''), if(t = 'High', ',"temperature": "High"', '')), concat(concat(if(h = 'High', ',"humidity": "High"', ''), if(v = 'High', ',"vibration": "High"', '')), if(p = 'High', ',"pollutants": "High"', ''))), 2), '}'))) AS o WHERE erf > 4 ORDERED WITH erf DESCENDING

LIST id, t, lvl, hs, cs FROM ArtifactRating has ArtifactsCore a AND ALSO has ArtifactRatingHistSign hs AND ALSO has ArtifactRatingCulturalScore cs AND ALSO a has ArtifactsCoreARTregID id AND ALSO a has ArtifactsCoreTitle t AND ALSO a is of RiskAssessment has RiskAssessmentLevel lvl WHERE (lvl = 'High' OR lvl = 'Medium') AND hs > 8 AND cs > 20

LIST id, tetl FROM ArtifactsCore a has ArtifactsCoreARTregID id AND ALSO OPTIONALLY has ArtifactsCoreAgeYears age AND ALSO a is of RiskAssessment has RiskAssessmentLevel lvl AND ALSO a is of SensitivityData s AND ALSO s OPTIONALLY has SensitivityDataEnvironmentLight l AND ALSO s OPTIONALLY has SensitivityDataEnvironmentTemperature t AND ALSO s OPTIONALLY has SensitivityDataEnvironmentHumidity h AND ALSO s OPTIONALLY has SensitivityDataEnvironmentVibration v AND ALSO s OPTIONALLY has SensitivityDataEnvironmentPollutants p AND ALSO a is of ConditionAssessment has LightAndRadiationReading lr AND ALSO lr has LightAndRadiationReadingLux lux AND ALSO lr has LightAndRadiationReadingVisLxh vis AND ALSO lr has EnvironmentalReadingsCore e AND ALSO e has EnvironmentalReadingsCoreTEMPc tc AND ALSO e has EnvironmentalReadingsCoreRH rh AND ALSO (if(l = 'Low', 1, if(l = 'Medium', 5, if(l = 'High', 10, 0))) + if(t = 'Low', 1, if(t = 'Medium', 5, if(t = 'High', 10, 0))) + if(h = 'Low', 1, if(h = 'Medium', 5, if(h = 'High', 10, 0))) + if(v = 'Low', 1, if(v = 'Medium', 5, if(v = 'High', 10, 0))) + if(p = 'Low', 1, if(p = 'Medium', 5, if(p = 'High', 10, 0)))) / 5 AS erf AND ALSO (lux * if(l = 'Low', 1, if(l = 'Medium', 5, if(l = 'High', 10, 0))) * vis) / 1000 AS ler AND ALSO (age * erf * power(rh - 50, 2) * tc) / 100000 AS mdr AND ALSO (erf + ler + (mdr * 2)) AS tetl WHERE lvl = 'Medium' ORDERED WITH tetl DESCENDING THE FIRST 10

LIST id, t, d, cpi, IF cpi > 7 THEN 'High Priority' ELSE IF cpi > 4 THEN 'Medium Priority' ELSE 'Low Priority' FROM ArtifactRating has ArtifactsCore a AND ALSO has ArtifactRatingHistSign hs AND ALSO has ArtifactRatingResearchScore rs AND ALSO has ArtifactRatingCulturalScore cs AND ALSO a has ArtifactsCoreARTregID id AND ALSO a has ArtifactsCoreTitle t AND ALSO a has ArtifactsCoreDynasty d AND ALSO a OPTIONALLY has ArtifactsCoreConserveStatus st AND ALSO ((hs + rs + cs) * (10 - if(st = 'Excellent', 1, if(st = 'Good', 3, if(st = 'Fair', 5, if(st = 'Poor', 7, if(st = 'Critical', 10, nullif(1, 1)))))))) / 30 AS cpi WHERE d = 'Ming' OR d = 'Qing' ORDERED WITH cpi DESCENDING

LIST id, nm, tc, rh, hc, IF mdr > 5 AND hc >= 2 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' FROM ArtifactsCore a has ArtifactsCoreARTregID id AND ALSO OPTIONALLY has ArtifactsCoreTitle nm AND ALSO OPTIONALLY has ArtifactsCoreAgeYears age AND ALSO a is of ConditionAssessment has LightAndRadiationReading has EnvironmentalReadingsCore e AND ALSO e OPTIONALLY has EnvironmentalReadingsCoreTEMPc tc AND ALSO e OPTIONALLY has EnvironmentalReadingsCoreRH rh AND ALSO a OPTIONALLY is of SensitivityData s AND ALSO s OPTIONALLY has SensitivityDataEnvironmentLight l AND ALSO s OPTIONALLY has SensitivityDataEnvironmentTemperature t AND ALSO s OPTIONALLY has SensitivityDataEnvironmentHumidity h AND ALSO s OPTIONALLY has SensitivityDataEnvironmentVibration v AND ALSO s OPTIONALLY has SensitivityDataEnvironmentPollutants p AND ALSO (if(l = 'Low', 1, if(l = 'Medium', 5, if(l = 'High', 10, 0))) + if(t = 'Low', 1, if(t = 'Medium', 5, if(t = 'High', 10, 0))) + if(h = 'Low', 1, if(h = 'Medium', 5, if(h = 'High', 10, 0))) + if(v = 'Low', 1, if(v = 'Medium', 5, if(v = 'High', 10, 0))) + if(p = 'Low', 1, if(p = 'Medium', 5, if(p = 'High', 10, 0)))) / 5 AS erf AND ALSO (if(l = 'High', 1, 0) + if(t = 'High', 1, 0) + if(h = 'High', 1, 0) + if(v = 'High', 1, 0) + if(p = 'High', 1, 0)) AS hc AND ALSO (age * erf * power(rh - 50, 2) * tc) / 100000 AS mdr ORDERED WITH id ASCENDING

LIST cid FROM DISTINCT EnvironmentalReadingsCore has Showcase has ShowcaseCaseID cid AND ALSO OPTIONALLY has EnvironmentalReadingsCoreTempVar24 tv AND ALSO OPTIONALLY has EnvironmentalReadingsCoreRHvar hv WHERE tv > 1 OR hv > 3 ORDERED WITH cid ASCENDING

LIST cid FROM DISTINCT Showcase c has ShowcaseCaseID cid AND ALSO OPTIONALLY has ShowcasePhysicalStateLeakRatePerDay lk AND ALSO OPTIONALLY has ShowcasePhysicalStateSealState ss AND ALSO OPTIONALLY has ShowcaseMaintenanceMaintStatus ms AND ALSO OPTIONALLY has ShowcaseMaintenanceFilterStatus fs AND ALSO OPTIONALLY has ShowcaseMaintenanceSilicaStatus sc AND ALSO c OPTIONALLY is of EnvironmentalReadingsCore e AND ALSO e OPTIONALLY has EnvironmentalReadingsCoreTempVar24 tv AND ALSO e OPTIONALLY has EnvironmentalReadingsCoreRHvar hv AND ALSO (10 - ((tv + (hv / 5) + lk) / 3)) AS sesr AND ALSO (if(ss = 'Poor', 1, 0) + if(ms = 'Overdue', 1, 0) + if(fs = 'Replace Now', 1, 0) + if(sc = 'Replace Now', 1, 0)) AS mi WHERE sesr < 5 OR mi >= 3 ORDERED WITH cid ASCENDING
